answer: Vesting with clawback resists sybils: earned coin unlocks slowly like a glacier, not all at once, and only sustained honest conduct carries an account to its full vault. A fake caught before its stake matures forfeits everything unvested — the slash claws it back with each pulse of the audit. A horde of disposable accounts that grab and vanish never reaches payout, so hit-and-run extraction simply stops paying.
